declarations.name: Poincare.DeTurckPullbackTwoJet.pullback_twoJet_congr
declarations.lean_type:
∀ (E : Type u) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
(h F : E → (E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] ℝ)) (phi : E → E) (z : E),
ContDiffAt ℝ 2 h (phi z) → ContDiffAt ℝ 2 F (phi z) →
ContDiffAt ℝ 3 phi z →
h (phi z) = F (phi z) →
fderiv ℝ h (phi z) = fderiv ℝ F (phi z) →
fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ h) (phi z) = fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ F) (phi z) →
let T := fun (q : E → (E →L[ℝ] E →L[ℝ] ℝ)) (y : E) =>
 Poincare.pullbackBilinearForm (q (phi y)) (fderiv ℝ phi y)
T h z = T F z ∧ fderiv ℝ (T h) z = fderiv ℝ (T F) z ∧
 fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (T h)) z = fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ (T F)) z
